experience.text: Web Services Description Language was developed by World Wide Web Consortium
World Wide Web Consortium was founded by Tim Berners-Lee
Tim Berners-Lee is a citizen of United Kingdom
United Kingdom is located in the continent of Europe
Web Services Description Language was developed by Sega AM2
Sega AM2 was founded by Raila Odinga
Raila Odinga is a citizen of Kenya
Kenya is located in the continent of Africa
On which continent is the country located, whose citizen is the founder of the company that developed Web Services Description Language?
